summary: Continuation of the 2026-11-21 optimisation session on one Modal Tesla T4: lockstep validation replayed on fixed checkpoints, a PPO collection profile, a bounds-checked int32 transfer for the overlapped pipeline, the torch.compile baseline diagnosis and, for the uncommitted grouped-kernel patch, a tile-model sweep, grouped execution inside the pipeline and a 48M sparse check. Synthetic workloads and synthetic checkpoints only; no market data uploaded. Rows with requires_protected_patch=true measure the uncommitted kernels.py/prepared.py/pipelined.py patch and are not a property of any committed revision.

validation_replay.scope: validation replay of fixed checkpoints on the CPU reference simulator; per policy device and mode, wall time of all evaluation seeds

collection_profile.scope: PPO collect_rollouts of the trainer's model and environments; microseconds per vector step
collection_profile.note: pack_host_copies rows measured a change that was rejected and reverted (no gain)

tile_model.fit: seeds 21-22 at 2M records (16 families); held out: seed 23 at 2M, seed 24 at 0.5M and 8M; see planning/optimize-2026-11-22/fit_tile_model.py

compile_baseline_diagnostic.finding: inductor lowers int64 index_add to index_put_(accumulate=True): radix sort + indexing_backward_kernel instead of eager atomic scatter
